remaining_questions.question: Letter ב (first letter): is a dagesh dot printed inside the bet? The candidate has none. The shva below is confirmed, but at native resolution a dot inside the bowl can neither be confirmed nor ruled out.

Letter ק: the holam dot at the qof's upper left is confirmed. Is a separate dagesh printed inside the qof, as the candidate has (קֹּ)? No separate dot inside could be made out from the surrounding ink. There is no dagesh in the tav.
Letter ש (second letter): is a dagesh printed inside the shin, as the candidate has (שְּׁ)? The shin dot and shva are confirmed; a dagesh inside the letter cannot be separated from them.

verdict: I checked every printed word, vowel, maqaf and plene/defective spelling of s290 against the four wide bands, the native s290.jpg, and the corrected lines-full crops 02, 04, 05 and 10. Nothing is clipped in the lower zone. All consonants, maqafs and spellings match the candidate. One punctuation patch is proposed: the printed full stop after שַׁבָּת in the rubric. Three single-dot dagesh questions remain open, and the image cannot settle them: the ב of בְאָזְנֵי, the ק of חַקֹּתָ and the ש of מִשְּׁמֵי. So pointing approval is withheld. I did not reread the English on s291, as instructed, because it was fully checked in the previous pass.
